temana.p: [Timu+ṇe+yu.(temanamasaṃ)] (na) CL=7 (1) (A) It is wet (with water). (B) Happen attachment and Craving for something (by the power of greed). See - Temanakaraṇa. (C) It happens attachment (with pleasure). (Ti) (2) (Nether garment etc.,) which is wet. See also -  temanatā, temanarukkha. Temana(na) [timu+ṇe+yu] To be wet (with water), Pouring with water. See also - Temanasamattha. Temana(na) [temana+bhāva. Nokapudakye.]  As it can wet, See - Temanaṭṭha.

DOP: temāsa m.n. [ from ti 2 + māsa 2 ], a period of three months; three months ; Vin III 230, 4 (icchām’ ahaṃ bhikkhave ~aṃ paṭisalliyituṃ); M I 438, 6 (āyasmā Bhaddāli sabbaṃ taṃ ~aṃ na bhagavato sammukhībhāvaṃ adāsi); S V 326, 1 (tassa ~assa accayena); Ja IV 131, 2 (~aṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ bhāvetvā); Vism 92, 13 (so ~aṃ pi tattha piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjitvā); Sv 737, 3 (imasmiṃ ~e); Dhp-a I 290, 14 (sace ayyā imaṃ ~aṃ idha vasissanti); Ud-a 330, 9 (ito ~ato uddhaṃ).
NCP: masculine & neuter a | temaasa period of three months; three months.

temāsika.p: [Timāsa+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 [Temāsa+ika] (A) A pregnancy or conception which life is three months. (B) His age is three months (after birthing), One who is three months old. See - Addhamāsika. (C) (Offering articles) which is always offering during three months. (D) (The practice) which makes efforts in those three months. (E) (The practice) which can finish in those three months. (F) (The practice) which is completion in three months. (G) It is related to three months, It is three kinds which involves in these three months.
